definition: Every word this workbench uses, defined in plain terms in one place. Each definition either cites a published work the corpus already names or is marked editorial and quotes the corpus file it rests on.
basis: Editorial. The glossary is the workbench's own record set, ruled for Phase 14, and no corpus file describes it. It keeps VISION.md's rule for every figure: "Every number carries a source or is explicitly labelled as an editorial judgment."

surface.what: Every word this workbench uses, defined in plain terms, with what each definition rests on.
read: Each definition either cites a published work or is marked editorial and names the corpus file it read.
A word with two meanings has two entries, and each names the other.
Words are grouped by family; narrow the list by family or by typing.
